"My friends and ME". Basic grammar. A clause contains - at a minimum - a subject and a verb. It can have only one subject.

The subject here is "My friends". The object is "ME". We cannot use "I" in the object position.

Same as when we say "Between you and ME", not "between you and I".

All prepositions (here, "between") are followed by objects, not by subjects.
